question: 'Gaan-Ngai' festival is celebrated in which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaan-Ngai** is a traditional festival celebrated by the **Zeliangrong community**, primarily residing in the northeastern state of **Manipur**. The festival holds great cultural and religious significance for this community.
 
• The festival marks the end of the harvest season and the beginning of a new year. It is a time for thanksgiving to the deities and ancestors for their blessings and protection.
 
• Gaan-Ngai is celebrated with vibrant rituals, traditional dances, songs, and feasts. Ritual offerings are made to the ancestors, and people seek blessings for prosperity and well-being in the coming year.
 
• The festival typically lasts for **five days** and falls in the month of **December or January**, according to the **lunar calendar**.
 
• Gaan-Ngai is not only a religious event but also a social occasion that strengthens communal bonds and preserves the rich cultural heritage of the Zeliangrong people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zeliangrong Community:**

 
 
• The Zeliangrong community is a major indigenous group in the northeastern states of **Manipur, Nagaland, and Assam**. They are known for their unique customs, traditions, and festivals.
 
• The community's name "Zeliangrong" is derived from the three sub-groups: **Zeme, Liangmai, and Rongmei**.
 
• The Zeliangrong people practice a blend of traditional animistic beliefs and Christianity, and their festivals reflect this cultural duality.
 
 
 
• **Other Festivals of Manipur:**
 
 
• **Yaoshang:** Celebrated in spring, it is similar to Holi and involves cultural performances and sports events.
 
• **Ningol Chakouba:** A festival that strengthens family bonds, where married daughters are invited back to their parental homes for a feast.
 
• **Cheiraoba:** Marks the traditional new year of Manipur and is celebrated with offerings to deities and hill climbing rituals.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Gaan-Ngai:**
 
 
• The festival is a time to honor ancestors and seek blessings for the prosperity of the family and community.
 
• It serves as a platform for the younger generation to learn about their cultural heritage and traditional practices.
 
• The celebration fosters unity and harmony among the Zeliangrong people and strengthens their communal identity.
 
 
 
• **Key Highlights of Gaan-Ngai:**
 
 
• Rituals include the lighting of sacred fire, offering food and drinks to ancestors, and conducting religious prayers.
 
• Traditional dances like **Gaan Sammei** and songs are performed during the festival.
 
• The festival also includes community feasts, sports, and cultural competitions.
